title: Gradient systems and asymmetric relaxations in view of Riemannian geometry
summary: In dually flat manifolds, there is a deep connection between gradient flows and pregeodesics. This was one of the many important contributions of Amari to information geometry. In this paper, we extend the study of this relationship to general Riemannian manifolds. Our result does not impose conditions of flatness on the connection or symmetry on its non-metricity tensor, thus broadening the geometric setting beyond Hessian manifolds.
